description.p: A password manager that reads and writes vaults in the KeePass format (KDBX 4). The files stay compatible with KeePassXC, KeePass2 and KeePassDX. No account, no telemetry.

ul.li: Several vaults at once, folders, tags, attachments, history, TOTP
Password generator and password health check
Browser integration through the KeePassXC-Browser extension
Vaultwarden accounts, import from Bitwarden, 1Password and Proton Pass
